Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2904; powerless, i.e. without self-control:--incontinent.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in Paul's portrait of the last days: men will be without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good. The word is powerless over oneself — without self-control.
TheologicalSignificance: One word in a dark list carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the company it keeps, affection gone, promises broken, restraint gone, in a world that calls appetite freedom.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
